effect_description_eng:
＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card in your hand, return 1 level 6 or lower 2-color Digimon card that's red or purple from your trash to the hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] All of your opponent's Security Digimon get -3000 DP.
